<div class="page">

    <h1>AI Leadership Academy (AILA 2027)</h1>
    <p class="sub">Leading Statistics and Data Science in the Age of AI &mdash; a two-day intensive program at Rice University for academic and industry leaders.</p>

  <main class="content">
    <h2>About the Academy</h2>
    <p>The ASA Stats Up AI Interest Group is pleased to announce the <strong>Winter 2027 AI Leadership Academy (AILA)</strong>, hosted by the Department of Statistics at Rice University, in partnership with NISS and the ASA Caucus of Academic Representatives.</p>
    <p>The AI landscape is shifting rapidly, and leaders in statistics at all levels&mdash;from emerging team leads to senior administrators&mdash;are seeking to make their research, education, and team management AI-aware. AILA focuses on practical applications of AI for research and education, strategies for supporting team members in AI-aware and AI-augmented roles, and the design of tailored institutional initiatives.</p>
    <p>The community continues beyond the academy through monthly virtual check-ins, mentor connections, and a reunion at JSM 2027.</p>

    <h2>Who Should Apply</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>Academic scholars, educators, and industry leaders in statistics and data science.</li>
      <li>Department chairs, program directors, and research executives seeking to pilot AI initiatives in education, research, or institutional administration.</li>
    </ul>
    <p>The cohort is capped at 30 participants and curated for balance across career stages, leadership roles, and sectors.</p>

    <h2>Program Highlights</h2>
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Day 1 &mdash; AI for Research &amp; Education:</strong> leader talks and hands-on play sessions with Rafael Irizarry (Dana-Farber / Harvard), Hadley Wickham (Posit), Rebecca Nugent (Carnegie Mellon), Tian Zheng (Columbia), Shihao Yang (Georgia Tech), and Linjun Zhang (Rutgers), plus an evening improv workshop led by Richard Zink (JMP).</li>
      <li><strong>Day 2 &mdash; Design &amp; Synthesis:</strong> participants draft their own AI leadership initiatives with an assigned mentor, followed by peer review and resource planning.</li>
    </ul>

    <h2>Key Dates</h2>
    <table class="dates">
      <tr><td>October 1, 2026</td><td>Applications open</td></tr>
      <tr><td>October 15, 2026</td><td>Virtual info session, 12 PM ET (registration required)</td></tr>
      <tr><td>November 5, 2026</td><td>Application deadline</td></tr>
      <tr><td>November 24, 2026</td><td>Acceptance decisions sent</td></tr>
      <tr><td>January 7 &ndash; 8, 2027</td><td>Academy at Rice University</td></tr>
    </table>

    <p>Questions? Contact <a href="mailto:contact.AILA2027@gmail.com">contact.AILA2027@gmail.com</a>.</p>
